title: The AI Scientist: Towards Fully Automated Open-Ended Scientific Discovery

mechanism.domainTask: End-to-end automated scientific idea generation, experimentation, paper writing, and reviewing
mechanism.populationDetail: Research ideas and completed findings are kept in an incrementally growing archive; the paper specifies no island partition or genealogy tree.
mechanism.archiveDetail: A growing idea/findings archive with reviewer scores is explicit, but the archive's admission/removal rule is not specified as strict elite-only retention.
mechanism.replacementDetail: The maintained objects are scientific ideas/findings rather than code solutions. The archive is described as growing; whether every idea or only completed/reviewed ideas persist is not completely specified.
mechanism.generationDetail: Each new research idea is generated anew conditional on the archive; previous ideas are contextual references, not selected editable parents or fused source candidates.
mechanism.feedbackDetail: Idea ratings include interestingness, novelty, and feasibility; experimental metrics feed later experiments; reviewer scores and feedback can be added to the findings archive and inform future ideas.
mechanism.parentSelectionDetail: The idea prompt includes prior ideas as reference context but does not edit a selected parent idea. Aider later edits the experiment template for implementation; this is a different stage/artifact.
mechanism.outOfTaxonomy: An end-to-end autonomous research pipeline that generates ideas, runs experiments, writes papers, and performs simulated peer review.

provenance.citationWarning: The archive's retention rule is not explicit enough to call it a strict elite archive. Keep archive-conditioned idea generation distinct from downstream Aider code editing. Model count varies across runs because the generation model is replaceable and the reviewer may share GPT-4o; the workflow is role-specialized but not same-idea multi-model generation.
